context:
This item asks you to change a recorded ruling.
Goal: a session can merge its own small docs or rule-text edit without waiting for a batch runner, and nothing that moves a safety verdict gets through that way.
Problem (rule): PR 3474 builds a guard role named standing (hooks/guard_merge.py, merge/merge.py, merge/cloud_allow.json). It lets the coordinator and triage merge their own docs-only or rule-text PRs that touch no guard path. Your later words (00:50 and 00:53 CST Nov 15, ruling own-tiny-fixes-b) already say a standing session may do this. Two points are still open and only you can set them: how big a small rule-text edit may be (the gate has no size bound), and which sessions count (the lane built coordinator and triage only; the ruling says any standing session).
Based on (ruling): decision standing-merge-grant, your 2026-11-01 21:34 CST words: a batch runner runs every merge under the coordinator's grant, and the coordinator never merges. Ruling own-tiny-fixes-b (your 00:50 CST "so B" and 00:53 CST words, read by triage on roadmap) already supersedes that for docs-only and small rule-text edits; this item does not reopen that. It leaves two points.
Based on (read): lane hand-in 01:58 CST, relayed by the coordinator 01:59 CST: PR 3474 is open, draft, clean, head 02cc0586deab (triage read it on GitHub at 01:59 CST: 7 files, 333 additions, 43 deletions); round 1 sonnet PASS with no safety hole, a sonnet fix check passed. Built: coordinator and triage only. The consultant and the arbiter are refused.
Based on (read): the PR also adds the exact rule merge --role standing to the shared allow list (cloud_allow.json). Triage marks the merging options as widening because the page marks every allow-list entry. Your words at 00:59 CST (relayed by the consultant) already call the self-merge your own act, not a per-repo exception, so the mark is for the record.
Departs from: decision standing-merge-grant (the coordinator never merges; a batch runner runs every merge) and main's guard (only cs-build:batch-runner passes merge --role) — the coordinator and triage merge their own off-guard docs or rule edits; PR 3474 would set the size and the session list that your 00:50 CST ruling left open.
Who recommends what: the coordinator recommends adding a size bound first (option b). No option is starred, because the page never stars an option that adds an allow-list entry.
Meanwhile: PR 3474 queues behind PR 3381 and the docs combines at runner 10, and nothing merges through the new role until you answer. Leftover lines that still say the coordinator never merges (session-tiers about lines 86 and 97, hooks/session_start.sh, settings.json, records auto-mode-owner-acts and standing-merge-grant) get their own lane after your answer.
holds: The merge of PR 3474, which lets a standing session merge its own small edit, waits on this answer.
